scripts.typecheck: wrangler types --check --include-runtime false --strict-vars false --env-interface CloudflareBindings && tsc --noEmit

ARTIFACTS.description: Select the Cloudflare Artifacts namespace containing the repository to build.

BACKUP_BUCKET.description: R2 bucket used to store workspace Snapshots between runners.

BACKUP_BUCKET_NAME.description: Use the same name as the `BACKUP_BUCKET` R2 bucket.

CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Cloudflare account ID where this CI Worker runs.

CLOUDFLARE_DEPLOY_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Cloudflare account ID where pipeline deployments are created. This can be the same as `CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID`.

CF_TOKEN.description: Cloudflare API token used by pipeline runners. Create one from the [API Tokens page](https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens).

R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: R2 access key ID used by Sandbox to save workspace Snapshots.

R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: R2 secret access key used by Sandbox to save workspace Snapshots.
